text:
alex: Heads up: ~0.7% of traces in last 24h have empty billing.key after span->meta migration. This breaks per-tenant cost dashboards.

priya: Any samples? Is the key missing in the envelope or stripped during ingest?

alex: Sample:
```
# before
trace.span.tags["budget"] = "acct:acme:env:prod"
# after
trace.meta.billing.key = "acct:acme:env:prod"
```
Some spans arrive with neither; correlated with requests hitting pre-sampler in edge.

ashwin: Makes sense. Pre-sampler drops span tags before transform runs, so billing.key never materializes.

lucy: Two mitigations: (1) write a short-lived X-Billing-Key header at ingress pre-sample, or (2) have stitcher reconstruct billing.key from tenant+user heuristics during enrich.

priya: Header is deterministic. We can implement via a tiny wasm filter in edge so hosted customers don't need SDK changes. Must HMAC the header to avoid leaking tenant info.

ashwin: Agreed. Header approach costs CPU at ingress; KMS per-tenant salt needed for HMAC. We can cache salts to avoid frequent KMS calls.

alex: Reconstruction fallback still useful for old SDKs. It should tag traces with billing.key_source:reconstructed so BI can filter.

priya: Proposed plan:
- implement edge wasm filter to emit X-Billing-Key:HMAC(billing.key) pre-sampler (tenant toggle)
- stitcher: prefer header if present, else run reconstruction heuristic for 14 days
- CI test: run traces with sampler on/off and assert billing coverage >= 99.9%
- telemetry panels: % missing billing.key, header-present vs reconstructed, stitcher errors

lucy: Rollout: staging -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 72h. Monitor header share and wasm CPU. Abort if missing_billing_key > 0.5% or wasm CPU adds >5% node CPU.

ashwin: I'll prototype the wasm filter in Rust, include microbenchmarks (median CPU delta, allocs /10k reqs, cold-starts). Will add a dev knob to disable HMAC for local testing.

infra-bot: deploy: billing-header-wasm-proto -> staging succeeded (1781240200) :white_check_mark:

alex: Ping me when you have staging logs to validate HMAC shapes. Lucy will draft the RFC addendum covering privacy and KMS salt rotation.

priya: I'll own the stitcher PR and the CI compatibility test. Alex will own rollout.

lucy: I will draft the addendum and the dashboards. Will include the exact PromQL for alerts.

alex: Thanks team, canary next Tuesday if staging looks good.
